title: Sozu
description: Gain 1 energy at the start of each turn. You can no longer obtain potions.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Sozu prevents the player from obtaining potions from any source (rewards, shops, etc.) while granting 1 additional energy per turn as compensation. The restriction applies to potion procurement — active relics and other effects that grant potions are still possible through other means.
